decision: Adopt pinned local runtime; adapt focused routing
import: Complete archify subtree. SKILL.md preserved as SKILL.upstream.md; focused SKILL.md and generate.mjs added. No upstream source changes.

review.runtimeDependencies: Node built-ins and pre-generated validators/icons; no npm installation required. PNG export reuses sibling hyperframes/runtime puppeteer-core.
review.network: Renderer is local. Adapter disables update checks; PNG browser aborts non-file/data/blob requests. Raw CLI update/brand commands remain present but outside admitted workflow.
review.storage: Caller-selected outputs and upstream renderer atomic-output sidecars; no global service.

verification.evidence: Generated HTML, PNG and Markdown. Exercised theme switching, keyboard node activation and Redis search/focus. SVG export parsed successfully and retained all ten node labels. Unfocused reduced-motion view reported zero animations; readable diagram observed in browser.
verification.limitations: SVG download payload was observed through the actual export action; browser download-list tracking returned no entries. PNG generation passed; other export formats and full assistive-technology audit were not exercised. Reduced-motion initial view had zero animations; focused view retained seven finite 180ms transitions, so this is not a zero-motion guarantee.

risks: Local generation and interaction were exercised; this does not establish browser sandbox security or exhaustive diagram-type accessibility.
Static preview requires sibling HyperFrames runtime.
Brand vector use retains individual trademark/license restrictions.
